question:
Solve the following expression.

[7 + 30 ÷ 6 - (6 + 6) + 7]
solution:
Given :

[7 + 30 ÷ 6 - (6 + 6) + 7]

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/833bf95aed1ad9b2103d937814ed938d64f5ca098f7062f9d7bf16f1d7d38879.png] 

Calculation :

[7 + 30 ÷ 6 - (6 + 6) + 7]

⇒ 7 + 5 - 12 + 7

⇒ 19 - 12

⇒ 7

∴ The answer is 7.
